chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from Abān—I only know that he mentioned it—from Abī Ḥamzah, who said:
Whenever ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام saw a جنازة approaching, he would say: “All praise is for Allah, who has not made me among the abruptly taken multitude.”

key_terms.السَّوَادِ: the mass or multitude of people
key_terms.الْحَمْدُ: praise and thanks directed to Allah
key_terms.الْمُخْتَرَمِ: those cut off suddenly by death
key_terms.جَنَازَةً: a funeral bier or funeral procession

ai.seo_question: What did Imām ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام say when he saw a funeral procession?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a saying of ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام upon seeing a funeral procession. It expresses praise to Allah for continued life and serves as a reminder of death, human vulnerability, and gratitude.
